browser.title: Sign in to Amazon
browser.description:
1. [Open the Amazon sign-in page]({url}) and sign in as usual (passkey, two-step verification and captcha all work).
2. When you land on a blank or "page not found" page, copy the full address from the browser's address bar.
3. Paste it below.

shared_session.title: Real-time updates are off for {name}
shared_session.description:
This account uses the session imported from Alexa Media Player. Amazon allows a single real-time connection per sign-in, so while Alexa Media Player is set up Amazon Echo checks for changes every 60 seconds instead of receiving them as they happen.

To get real-time updates, do one of these:

- Open the Amazon Echo integration, choose **Reconfigure** and pick **Sign in with Amazon in your browser**. That gives this integration a sign-in of its own.
- Or remove (or disable) Alexa Media Player and reload Amazon Echo.
